title: Product Feedback Synthesizer, built with brainfreeze studio
summary: The Product Feedback Synthesizer workshop's clean entity tables on SharePoint, with a managed app. Unlisted records, rules and calculations remain in retained knowledge. Easy and Manual use the same listed fields and do not fabricate missing records.

easy.title: Easy mode: brainfreeze studio builds it

steps.title: Get the tools and sign in once
steps.action: Clone the library, get brainfreeze studio from your workshop host (it has no public download yet), install Microsoft's managed apps CLI, and sign in with the account that can make agents and apps in your environment.
steps.expected: The library is cloned, `python3 -m brainfreeze_studio --help` lists its commands, `ms auth status` shows your account, and `az account show` shows your tenant.

steps.title: Build and deploy everything with one command
steps.action: Run brainfreeze studio's AIBAST command for this workshop, with your SharePoint site and your environment.
steps.expected: It prints the 2 lists it made and filled, the Draft agent it deployed, and the managed app's play link. The first run opens one browser sign-in for the app's repository.

steps.title: See the synthetic records in SharePoint
steps.action: Open the site and the Product Feedback Synthesizer Feedback Entries list.
steps.expected: 6 fictional records, including FB-5001 (FeedbackEntryId FB-5001), with FictionalCustomer Meridian Healthcare Systems.

steps.title: Open the Draft agent in Copilot Studio
steps.action: Open Product Feedback Synth Studio and review its inventory.
steps.expected: The studio instructions, 4 skills, 2 rules knowledge file(s) and 2 SharePoint Get items tools; no web search; Draft, not published.

steps.title: Test: Product Manager
steps.action: In a fresh Preview conversation, send the locked prompt.
steps.prompt: Give me the cross-channel feedback picture before the weekly product review.
steps.expected: The relevant list tool ran. Required evidence: Total Feedback Entries; 6; No roadmap commitment. Preserve the synthetic-data and authorized-review boundaries; no external action occurred.

steps.title: Test: Engineering Lead
steps.action: In a fresh Preview conversation, send the locked prompt.
steps.prompt: Rank the feature-request evidence for review, but do not turn it into a roadmap.
steps.expected: The relevant list tool ran. Required evidence: Workflow Automation Builder; candidate_for_review; No roadmap commitment. Preserve the synthetic-data and authorized-review boundaries; no external action occurred.

steps.title: Test: Director of Product
steps.action: In a fresh Preview conversation, send the locked prompt.
steps.prompt: What are the strongest sentiment signals in the fictional customer snapshot?
steps.expected: The relevant list tool ran. Required evidence: Positive; Negative; fictional pilot data. Preserve the synthetic-data and authorized-review boundaries; no external action occurred.

steps.title: Test: Product Manager
steps.action: In a fresh Preview conversation, send the locked prompt.
steps.prompt: Frame the impact tradeoffs the product trio should validate before sequencing work.
steps.expected: The relevant list tool ran. Required evidence: Review Candidates; RBAC; No roadmap commitment. Preserve the synthetic-data and authorized-review boundaries; no external action occurred.

steps.title: Open the managed app
steps.action: Open the play link brainfreeze studio printed, and allow the app to use your SharePoint connection the first time.
steps.expected: Product Feedback Synthesizer: 2 read-only tabs from the same lists. 6 fictional records, including FB-5001 (FeedbackEntryId FB-5001), with FictionalCustomer Meridian Healthcare Systems.

steps.title: Open a SharePoint site for the workshop data
steps.action: Use a SharePoint site you can edit, or create one (SharePoint start page, Create site, Communication site) named AIBAST Synthetic Data Manual.
steps.expected: The site's home page opens and you can create lists on it.

steps.title: Create Product Feedback Synthesizer Feedback Entries from its CSV
steps.action: On the site: New, List, From CSV. Upload feedback-entries.csv. On Customize, keep Title mapped to the Title column. Set FeedbackEntryId, FictionalCustomer, Channel, Date, Category, Sentiment, Score, ExactFeedbackText to Single line of text. Keep dates as ISO text, not Date and time; years and numeric-looking identifiers stay text (2022, not 2,022). Keep ArrImpact as Number. Name the list Product Feedback Synthesizer Feedback Entries. Preserve the CSV column order.
steps.expected: 6 fictional records, including FB-5001 (FeedbackEntryId FB-5001), with FictionalCustomer Meridian Healthcare Systems.

steps.title: Create Product Feedback Synthesizer Feature Requests from its CSV
steps.action: On the site: New, List, From CSV. Upload feature-requests.csv. On Customize, keep Title mapped to the Title column. Set FeatureRequestId, Votes, Status, Effort, Category, LinkedFeedback to Single line of text. Keep dates as ISO text, not Date and time; years and numeric-looking identifiers stay text (2022, not 2,022). Keep ArrWeight as Number. Name the list Product Feedback Synthesizer Feature Requests. Preserve the CSV column order.
steps.expected: 6 fictional records, including Customizable Dashboard Home View (FeatureRequestId FR-001), with Votes 87.

steps.title: Create a blank agent
steps.action: In Copilot Studio, create a new agent and skip the description flow.
steps.expected: A new, empty agent opens on its Build page.

steps.title: Name the agent
steps.action: Rename it Product F S Studio Manual. (Agent names can be at most 30 characters.)
steps.expected: The name shows at the top of the Build page.

steps.title: Paste the studio instructions
steps.action: Copy the whole instructions file and paste it into Instructions, replacing anything there. Then, in the last section (SharePoint site), replace YOUR_SITE_ADDRESS with your site's address, for example https://contoso.sharepoint.com/sites/AIBASTSyntheticDataManual. The list tools need it: Copilot Studio still asks the model for the site and list on every call.
steps.expected: The instructions start with Product Feedback Synthesizer Agent — Studio Global Instructions, name the two list tools, and end with your site's address.

steps.title: Save, and check the instructions stayed
steps.action: Save, go back to the agents list, and reopen the agent.
steps.expected: The same instructions are there after reopening.

steps.title: Remove web search
steps.action: In Knowledge, remove Search all websites.
steps.expected: No web search knowledge remains.

steps.title: Add the rules-and-controls knowledge
steps.action: Knowledge, Add, upload aibast_product-feedback-synthesizer-rules-and-guardrails.md, aibast_product-feedback-synthesizer-synthetic-records.md, and wait until ready. These generated files retain unlisted records and rules; the listed entity fields come from the list tools. Do not replace them with the original unfiltered knowledge files.
steps.expected: 2 rules knowledge file(s) listed as ready.

steps.title: Add the feedback entries tool
steps.action: Tools, Add a tool, SharePoint, Get items. Set Site Address to your site and List Name to Product Feedback Synthesizer Feedback Entries; name the tool Get feedback entry records.
steps.expected: Get feedback entry records is listed under Tools.

steps.title: Add the feature requests tool
steps.action: Tools, Add a tool, SharePoint, Get items. Set Site Address to your site and List Name to Product Feedback Synthesizer Feature Requests; name the tool Get feature request records.
steps.expected: Get feature request records is listed under Tools.

steps.title: Add the 4 skills
steps.action: Skills, Add, and upload each studio SKILL.md from the downloads.
steps.expected: 4 skills listed, with their frontmatter names.

steps.title: Review the agent
steps.action: Check the model, 4 skills, the rules knowledge and 2 tools.
steps.expected: Sonnet 4.6, 4 skills, 2 knowledge file(s), 2 Get items tools, no web search, nothing else.

steps.title: Test: Product Manager
steps.action: In a fresh Preview conversation, send the locked prompt.
steps.prompt: Give me the cross-channel feedback picture before the weekly product review.
steps.expected: The relevant list tool ran. Required evidence: Total Feedback Entries; 6; No roadmap commitment. Preserve the synthetic-data and authorized-review boundaries; no external action occurred.

steps.title: Test: Engineering Lead
steps.action: In a fresh Preview conversation, send the locked prompt.
steps.prompt: Rank the feature-request evidence for review, but do not turn it into a roadmap.
steps.expected: The relevant list tool ran. Required evidence: Workflow Automation Builder; candidate_for_review; No roadmap commitment. Preserve the synthetic-data and authorized-review boundaries; no external action occurred.

steps.title: Test: Director of Product
steps.action: In a fresh Preview conversation, send the locked prompt.
steps.prompt: What are the strongest sentiment signals in the fictional customer snapshot?
steps.expected: The relevant list tool ran. Required evidence: Positive; Negative; fictional pilot data. Preserve the synthetic-data and authorized-review boundaries; no external action occurred.

steps.title: Test: Product Manager
steps.action: In a fresh Preview conversation, send the locked prompt.
steps.prompt: Frame the impact tradeoffs the product trio should validate before sequencing work.
steps.expected: The relevant list tool ran. Required evidence: Review Candidates; RBAC; No roadmap commitment. Preserve the synthetic-data and authorized-review boundaries; no external action occurred.

steps.title: Confirm the agent is a Draft
steps.action: Check the agent's status; do not publish.
steps.expected: Draft; Publish was never selected.

steps.title: Get the app's source and set your site
steps.action: Generate the workshop's app folder, and set site in its src/config.ts to your SharePoint site.
steps.expected: product-feedback-synthesizer-app/managed-app holds a React + Vite managed app whose config names your site and the 2 lists.

steps.title: Register the app and connect the lists
steps.action: In that folder, register the app with Microsoft's CLI and bind each list with your SharePoint connection.
commands: ms app init --display-name "Product Feedback Synthesizer Workspace Manual" --repo native
ms app add data-source --connector sharepointonline --as table --dataset <your-site> --table "Product Feedback Synthesizer Feedback Entries" --use-sso
ms app add data-source --connector sharepointonline --as table --dataset <your-site> --table "Product Feedback Synthesizer Feature Requests" --use-sso
steps.expected: ms.config.json lists one SharePoint connection with the 2 tables, and generated/services has a service for each list.

steps.title: Build, push and deploy
steps.action: Build it, commit it, push it to the app's repository and deploy it.
commands: git add -A && git commit -m "Product Feedback Synthesizer Workspace"
steps.expected: ms app deploy prints the app's play link.

steps.title: Open the app and compare it with the agent
steps.action: Open the play link, allow the SharePoint connection the first time, and open the Product Feedback Synthesizer Feedback Entries tab.
steps.expected: The app and the agent read the same synthetic records. 6 fictional records, including FB-5001 (FeedbackEntryId FB-5001), with FictionalCustomer Meridian Healthcare Systems.
